The weekday 17:30 "Pod end of day" note is scheduled (job b643e1e4e8c3), but it won't run until the Hermes gateway is started. Its next run is Mon 26 Oct, so there's no note today.

I posted three messages in #strategic-pod, which I shouldn't have done. The first said today's note was not going to happen, which was wrong. The second corrected that and then reversed itself. The third gives the right answer. I can't delete them, so the thread will show all three.

The job posts the day's new messages from #strategic-pod. It will run at 22:30 UTC, which is 17:30 Chicago time while daylight time is in effect.
